_note: Hand-labeled scenarios for llm_client.judge_contract_change() -- the ambiguous-change judgment layer contract_agent.py falls back to when a rule can't decide (a reworded event_type, a menu description edit). Every case here is deliberately chosen to have a CLEAR, defensible expected category (escalate vs review) -- not a genuinely 50/50 borderline call -- so a mismatch is a meaningful signal about the model's judgment, not just noise from picking an unfair test case. See evaluate_llm_judgment.py: this is a LIVE eval, makes real billed API calls, and is never auto-run by anything else.
